initializer.cfg_yaml:
DATALOADER:
  NUM_INSTANCE: 8
  NUM_WORKERS: 4
  SAMPLER: softmax_triplet
DATASETS:
  NAMES: RGBNT201
  ROOT_DIR: ..
INPUT:
  PADDING: 10
  PIXEL_MEAN:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PIXEL_STD:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PROB: 0.5
  RE_PROB: 0.5
  SIZE_TEST:
  - 256
  - 128
  SIZE_TRAIN:
  - 256
  - 128
MODEL:
  ADAPTER: false
  ATT_DROP_RATE: 0.0
  DEVICE: cuda
  DEVICE_ID: '0'
  DIRECT: 1
  DIST_TRAIN: false
  DROP_OUT: 0.0
  DROP_PATH: 0.1
  FROZEN: false
  Gram_Loss_weight: 0.2
  ID_LOSS_TYPE: softmax
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  IF_LABELSMOOTH: 'on'
  IF_WITH_CENTER: 'no'
  METRIC_LOSS_TYPE: triplet
  MoE_Loss_weight: 0.1
  NAME: Signal
  NECK: bnneck
  NO_MARGIN: true
  PAT_Loss_weight: 0.2
  PRETRAIN_PATH_T: /data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt
  PROMPT: false
  SIE_CAMERA: true
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  SIE_VIEW: false
  STRIDE_SIZE:
  - 16
  - 16
  TOPK: 80
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: ViT-B-16
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
  USE_A: false
  USE_B: false
  stageName: together_CLS_Patch
OUTPUT_DIR: .
SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.00035
  BIAS_LR_FACTOR: 2
  CENTER_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.0005
  CENTER_LR: 0.5
  CHECKPOINT_PERIOD: 50
  CLUSTER_MARGIN: 0.3
  COSINE_MARGIN: 0.5
  COSINE_SCALE: 30
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  LARGE_FC_LR: false
  LOG_PERIOD: 10
  MARGIN: 0.3
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  MOMENTUM: 0.9
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: Adam
  RANGE_ALPHA: 0
  RANGE_BETA: 1
  RANGE_K: 2
  RANGE_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1
  RANGE_MARGIN: 0.3
  SEED: 42
  STEPS:
  - 40
  - 70
  WARMUP_FACTOR: 0.01
  WARMUP_ITERS: 10
  WARMUP_METHOD: linear
  WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.0001
  WEIGHT_DECAY_BIAS: 0.0001
TEST:
  EVAL: false
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 128
  MISS: nothing
  NECK_FEAT: before
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
ckpt_save_path: RGBNT201_all
ckpt_test_path: test_RNT201
initializer.scope: Same201 public initialization/raw author objectives; cross-spectral content and differentiable semantic reference. Dense readout and slot pooling are common to all three controls; no extra head/loss/resource.
